what: Per-problem rows of the cap32 cell base_cue (Base + cue, 328 harder problems, cap 32,768, T 1.0), same format as rows-01. analysis/cap32_rows.py writes only rows-01, so these rows were written by the one-off command below, run from the repository root of a worktree whose sibling ../iterate-hack-shots holds the raw answers.
command:
python3 -c '
import json
src = "../iterate-hack-shots/runs/cap32_base_cue_joined/answers.jsonl"
KEEP = ("problem_index", "unique_id", "n_new", "cap_hit", "score_v3", "extracted_v3", "gold")
rows = sorted(map(json.loads, open(src)), key=lambda r: r["problem_index"])
ref = [json.loads(l) for l in open("studies/rlneurons/results/cap32/rows-01/sft_cue.jsonl")]
assert len(rows) == 328 and [(r["problem_index"], r["unique_id"]) for r in rows] == [(r["problem_index"], r["unique_id"]) for r in ref]
assert all(r["sample"] == 0 and r["attempt"] == 0 for r in rows)
cell = json.load(open("studies/rlneurons/results/cap32/readout.json"))["cells"]["base_cue"]
r32 = sum(r["score_v3"] for r in rows)
r16 = sum(r["score_v3"] for r in rows if r["n_new"] <= 16384 and not r["cap_hit"])
late = [r for r in rows if r["n_new"] > 16384]
assert (r32, r16, len(late), sum(r["score_v3"] for r in late)) == (cell["right_at_32768"], cell["right_at_16384_same_answers"], cell["answers_longer_than_16384"], cell["of_them_right"])
with open("studies/rlneurons/results/cap32/rows-02/base_cue.jsonl", "w") as f:
    for r in rows:
        f.write(json.dumps({**{k: r[k] for k in KEEP}, "tail": r["text"][-400:]}) + "\n")
print(r32, r16, len(late), sum(r["score_v3"] for r in late))
'
raw_answers: runs/cap32_base_cue_joined/answers.jsonl (joined from 4 shards; not in git)
